Bug fix for the phone app. The watch app is unchanged from 2.2 (both files are attached for convenience).

- Fixed: on phones with shorter screens or larger text, the vibration pattern window was cut off and could not scroll, so the number box was out of reach. The window now scrolls, and jumps to the number box when you tap "Edit as numbers".

If you are coming from a version older than 2.2, install both files.
